headline: SpaceX Starship Booster Malfunctions During 15th Test Flight
summary: SpaceX completed a test flight returning the upper Starship craft to its launch tower, but the lower rocket booster malfunctioned and aborted, resulting in an explosion.
why: SpaceX is a private space exploration hardware and satellite operator developing fully reusable launch vehicles to lower orbital payload costs.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: SpaceX conducted its 15th Starship test flight where the booster section malfunctioned.
